# Copyright (c) 2026 agentctl contributors.
"""Run the real consent/applier boundary under an independent vetoing observer."""

import json
import os
import platform
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import click
from click.testing import CliRunner

from agentctl.bootstrap.prereqs import (
    GrantedPrerequisites,
    PackageInstall,
    apply,
    authorize,
    commands_of,
    ensure,
    invoke,
    probe,
    proposal,
)
from agentctl.check.audit import install
from agentctl.cli import cli
from agentctl.hostfacts import Distribution, HostContext, HostFacts, Prerequisite
from agentctl.result import Err, Ok
from agentctl.process import Output, SpawnError
from agentctl.result import Result


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Outcome:
    """Only non-secret, finite execution results cross the actor boundary."""

    reasons: tuple[str, ...]


def main() -> None:
    """Keep all executable discovery and every possible install in an owned PATH."""
    mode, directory_text, log_text, nonce = sys.argv[1:]
    directory, log = Path(directory_text), Path(log_text)
    binary = directory / "bin"
    binary.mkdir()
    compiler = binary / ("cc.exe" if platform.system() == "Windows" else "cc")
    compiler.write_text("discovery-only compiler candidate", encoding="utf-8")
    compiler.chmod(0o755)
    env = {**os.environ, "PATH": str(binary), "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"}
    context = HostContext("Linux", "x86_64", directory / "home", directory / "cache", directory, tuple(env.items()), is_root=False, interactive=False, assume_yes=False)
    installed = install(log, nonce)
    assert isinstance(installed, Ok)
    def unusable(arguments: tuple[str, ...], value: HostContext) -> Result[Output, SpawnError]:
        assert arguments[2:4] == ("-lgmp", "-o")
        return invoke((sys.executable, *arguments[1:]), value)

    measurements = probe(context, unusable, certificates=(None, None))
    assert isinstance(measurements, Ok)
    if mode in {"global-yes", "global-no"}:
        os.chdir(directory)
        arguments = ["--assume-yes", "check"] if mode == "global-yes" else ["check"]
        isolated = {
            "PATH": str(binary),
            "XDG_CACHE_HOME": str(directory / "xdg-cache"),
            "XDG_DATA_HOME": str(directory / "xdg-data"),
            "XDG_STATE_HOME": str(directory / "xdg-state"),
        }
        result = CliRunner().invoke(cli, arguments, env=isolated)
        assert result.exit_code == 1, result.output
        print(json.dumps({"reasons": ["preconditions"], "console": result.output}))
        return
    flags = mode in {"assume-yes", "root", "xcode"}
    interactive = mode in {"accepted", "batch", "declined", "declined-other", "declined-empty"}
    observations = (Prerequisite("xcode-clt", ready=False),) if mode == "xcode" else measurements.value
    facts = HostFacts("Darwin" if mode == "xcode" else "Linux", "x86_64", directory / "ghcup", None, None, None, distribution=Distribution("ubuntu", 24), is_root=mode == "root", interactive=interactive, assume_yes=flags, prerequisites=observations)
    planned = proposal(facts)
    assert isinstance(planned, Ok)
    assert len(planned.value) == 1
    action = planned.value[0]

    @click.command()
    def command() -> Outcome:
        if mode in {"batch", "declined", "declined-other", "declined-empty", "non-tty"}:
            result = ensure(action, facts, context)
            return Outcome((result.error.reason,) if isinstance(result, Err) else ("ready",))
        granted = authorize(action, facts)
        if isinstance(granted, Err):
            return Outcome((granted.error.reason,))
        reasons: tuple[str, ...] = ()
        if isinstance(action, PackageInstall):
            for argv in commands_of(action):
                single = GrantedPrerequisites(PackageInstall(action.packages, (argv,)))
                result = apply(single, context)
                reasons += (result.error.reason if isinstance(result, Err) else "ready",)
        else:
            result = apply(granted.value, context)
            reasons = (result.error.reason if isinstance(result, Err) else "ready",)
        return Outcome(reasons)

    answer = "yes\n" if mode in {"accepted", "batch"} else "unexpected\n" if mode == "declined-other" else "\n" if mode == "declined-empty" else "n\n"
    result = CliRunner().invoke(command, input=answer, standalone_mode=False)
    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
    outcome: object = result.return_value
    assert isinstance(outcome, Outcome)
    print(json.dumps({"reasons": outcome.reasons, "console": result.output}))


main()
